basic_info.description: Stately Ingleside Terrace residence with a perfect floor-plan for entertaining and gracious living. This Elegant Marina Style'' home sits on an enormous & level lot and has seven bedrooms and three full baths. The welcoming foyer leads to the formal rooms where details abound: Hardwood floors w/inlay, coved ceilings, built-ins and stain-grade wainscoting & trim. The main level includes a living room w/ fireplace, formal dining room, kitchen w/ breakfast area, three generous sized bedrooms and a full bath. Elevating to the top level is a spacious Primary Suite with a large en suite bath and a second bedroom. On the lower level is an open living area with a family room & wet bar, two large bedrooms w/ walk-in closets & bathrooms, and access to the rear yard. This light-filled home has abundant space to spread out. The garage can accommodate 2 cars and has multiple areas of storage space. The low maintenance yard awaits only imagination. A Forever Home'' like this won't happen again soon.
